title: Frequency Words
definition: Frequency words describe how often an action happens. They usually appear near the verb or after the conjugated verb in simple statements, though the exact position can vary with emphasis.

rules.title: Common frequency words
rules.explanation: Memorize the most useful words from always to never.

rules.title: Use frequency words in statements
rules.explanation: Place the frequency word naturally after the conjugated verb or later in the sentence.

examples.english: I always drink coffee in the morning.
We sometimes go to the cinema.

examples.german: Sie fährt selten mit dem Taxi.

rules.title: Ask how often
rules.explanation: Use Wie oft? to ask how frequently something happens.

examples.german: Ich mache dreimal pro Woche Sport.
examples.english: I exercise three times a week.
How often do you study German?

rules.title: Frequency plus time expressions
rules.explanation: Combine frequency words with daily, weekly, or monthly expressions.

examples.english: I go for a walk every day.

examples.german: Wir treffen uns einmal pro Woche.
Er besucht seine Eltern zweimal im Monat.
examples.english: He visits his parents twice a month.

common_mistakes.wrong: Ich gehe nie nicht ins Kino.
common_mistakes.explanation: Nie already means never; normally do not add nicht as a second negation.
Use wie oft to ask how frequently.

mastery_goal: You can describe how often you do daily activities and ask others about their routines.
